body_text:
Hi,

I am in a board meeting and cannot take calls. Please process an urgent wire transfer today. Our bank account changed, use the new account details I will send in a follow-up. Keep this confidential and do not discuss it with anyone until it is done.

Thanks,
James Wilson
CEO
label: phishing
notes: CEO 转账欺诈：免费邮箱冒充高管，使用紧迫感、保密要求与付款账户变更话术；即使 SPF/DKIM 通过也必须按语义与身份信号拦截。
